newsitem.title: UK: UK defence review will not be cost-driven-minister.
newsitem.headline: UK defence review will not be cost-driven-minister.

text.p: The new British government's defence review will not be driven by a desire to cut costs, Defence Secretary George Robertson told parliament on Monday.

Robertson was asked at question time by James Arbuthnot, who was defence procurement minister in the previous Conservative government, whether it was true that papers were circulating in the ministry of defence proposing a three billion pound cut in defence spending.
"I know of no papers suggesting budget cuts," Robertson said.

"What we will do is put the foreign policy priorities of this country first and then give the sense of clarity and direction to the forces of this country into how these roles can be properly and economically carried out," he added.
